verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a search platform with a cloud dashboard, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no assistant inside Meilisearch to which users can delegate tasks. The MCP server lets an external AI client manage indexes ("in the AI client you already use"), which is a different product role. Conversational search is a feature developers expose to their own end users, not an in-product task assistant, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
